title: Vegan Australian Burger
description: A tasty and juicy vegan Australian burger made with a flavorful patty and topped with fresh vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: black bean patty
ingredients.notes: made with black beans, oats, and spices

ingredients.name: fry bread bun
ingredients.notes: made with whole wheat flour and water

ingredients.name: juicy sauce
ingredients.notes: made with ketchup, vinegar, and spices

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Prepare the black bean patty according to package instructions.
Toast the fry bread bun on the pan for 2-3 minutes.
Spread 1 tbsp of juicy sauce on the bottom bun.
Add the black bean patty on top of the sauce.
Add sliced avocado, tomato, and lettuce on top of the patty.
Add the top bun and serve.
